description: Frozen, seeded incident bundle for the War-Room triage spike (W1). One incident, 200 log lines, 3 candidate causes with pinned evidence, per-service states over time, and the fix. The scorer derives the ranking from the log lines; it never reads ground_truth_cause_id.

causes.description: Exactly 3 candidate causes. support_count / contradict_count are the bundle author's counts of matching lines; the scorer recomputes its own counts from the log lines and they must agree.

contradicting_evidence.description: Log-line ids that weaken this cause. Shown on the card, not hidden.

pinned_evidence.description: Log-line ids that support this cause. Every id must exist in log_lines.

expected_effect.description: One-line before/after, e.g. 'error rate 61% → 9% in 90s'. Computed from the bundle's own log lines, not invented.

format_version.description: Bundle format version. Bump the minor version for additive changes, major for breaking changes.

ground_truth_cause_id.description: The correct cause. Stored in the bundle for verification ONLY. The scorer must never read this field — tests prove it by deleting/changing it and requiring identical output.

incident_window.description: The spike window the scorer weights most heavily (first minutes of the incident).

log_lines.description: Exactly 200 log lines, sorted by timestamp. The collapse input for W2.

seed.description: Seed shown on screen (e.g. 'Incident #4815'). Drives the generator; same seed reproduces the same bundle.

service_states.description: Per-service state at each timestamp, for the W4 time axis. Keys are service names; values are time-ordered state snapshots. The wavefront is derived from these.

title.description: One-sentence incident title shown at 0s in the demo, e.g. 'Checkout failing — 03:14'.

title: War-Room incident bundle
